diagnostics.releaseCaveat: iTunes dates are earliest observed exact-match catalog listings, not original-release ground truth. diagnostics.countMeaning: Exclusion counters count attempted candidate rows across channels, not distinct identities.
diagnostics.coverageCaveat: Bounded lookup windows, metadata availability and previous-shown exclusions affect success; this is not a full-catalog coverage measure.

coverageComparison.caveat: Saved track-level baseline vs current artist-level eligible-candidate coverage; API availability, time and exclusions differ.
